items.text: Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle injury; confirmed ruled out by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: WR1 void; boosts other MIN pass-catchers short-term.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off then ruled out with rib injury/strain. Full eval Monday; painful.
items.why: Rib injury mid-game; Schefter/Rapoport confirm ruled out.
items.implication: SF WR/TE target redistribution; Kittle/others up.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for remaining SF pass catchers.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury.
items.implication: NYJ RB vacuum; backups elevated for carries/snaps.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs with knee injury. Coach Hafley: 'does not sound optimistic' on severity.
items.why: Knee injury mid-game then ruled out; coach major concern for longer term.
items.implication: Major RB1 loss; monitor next tests. Handcuff/backup opportunity spikes.
items.opportunity: MIA RB committee expansion for remaining backs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active vs Cowboys after pregame workout testing hamstring; looked good. Likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout successful; Schefter/Rapoport confirm active though limited expected.
items.implication: Startable if rostered; reduces Bateman/Andrews upside.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role if limited snaps still high share.

items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries watching: Achane (knee), Jefferson (ankle), Hall (quad), Etienne (hamstring), Evans (rib), Mayfield (thumb)/McMillan (knee), Coker (quad), Andrews (hand), Spears (ankle), Bech (broken forearm).
items.why: Comprehensive post-slate list of impactful injuries for ongoing monitoring.
items.implication: Multiple high-value players status TBD for Week 4; waiver/handcuff alert.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated right thumb; MRI tomorrow. Coach Bowles confirms; likely to miss time per Rapoport.
items.implication: TB QB change impacts all skill players ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB opportunity; WR/RB usage shifts possible.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF.
items.implication: LAR WR targets to others (Adams etc).
items.opportunity: Volume spike for remaining Rams WRs.

items.text: Raiders WR Jack Bech broken forearm; headed to IR, return later this season.
items.why: Sources confirm broken forearm to IR.
items.implication: LV WR depth hit; opens snaps for others.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining Raiders WRs.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers active and making 2026 season debut vs Saints.
items.why: Confirmed active by Schefter/Rapoport after knee recovery.
items.implication: Elite TE1 immediate insert; Mayer secondary.
items.opportunity: High target/route share as featured TE.

items.text: With AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger), Jets WRs: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett etc. Expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide significant. High opportunity for Wilson.
items.why: Mitchell (12 targets prior) inactive; Levitan maps clear depth and Sadiq hybrid role.
items.implication: Wilson target monster potential; cheap WRs/DFS value.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets spike; Sadiq flex upside.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring; doctors estimate 3-4 week timeline (could return sooner). Already OUT Week 3; Keenum starting.
items.why: Schefter/Rapoport sources: Grade 2 hamstring normal recovery 3-4 weeks.
items.implication: CHI offense downgrade multi weeks; impacts all skill.
items.opportunity: Backup QB play; reduced efficiency for CHI weapons.

items.text: Zay Flowers active: risky but if active for Baltimore he's active for me. Start him over Bateman.
items.why: Berry prefers Flowers start over Bateman despite risk/limitation.
items.implication: Start Flowers if available; fade pure Bateman plays.
items.opportunity: Flowers still preferred volume even limited.

items.text: ETR/Levitan had Zay Flowers out in projections initially (possible play, late swap Bateman/Andrews DFS). Moore in (limited), Mitchell out. Updated with actives.
items.why: Conservative proj pre-workout; kept late swap ready. Moore limited assumption.
items.implication: DFS flexibility key; Flowers active changed Bateman value.
